validation.duplicate_variant: A variant can appear only once per receipt - enter a second lot of it as a separate receipt

error.variant_not_found: Variant #{{variant_id}} does not exist or was removed
error.variant_untracked: Variant #{{variant_id}} does not track stock, so it cannot be received
error.exchange_rate_unavailable: No exchange rate is published for {{currency}} on the receiving day - state the rate the invoice was converted at
error.canceled_locked: A canceled receipt can no longer be changed
error.confirmed_locked: A confirmed receipt has already moved stock - only the supplier document number and the notes can still change
error.status_changed: The receipt changed status while it was being edited - reload it and try again
error.no_items: A receipt with no lines cannot be confirmed
error.lot_consumed: Variant #{{variant_id}} has only {{remaining}} of {{qty}} left in this receipt's lot - stock already drawn from it cannot be canceled
error.lot_moved: Variant #{{variant_id}} already has a {{movement_type}} movement against this receipt's lot - stock that has moved cannot be canceled
error.delete_confirmed: A confirmed receipt cannot be deleted - cancel it instead
error.movement_append_only: Stock movements are never removed - post a reversing movement instead

history.deleted: Goods receipt(s) {{entity_ids}} marked as deleted by user #{{auth_id}}
history.status: Goods receipt #{{entity_id}} updated from {{oldStatus}} to {{newStatus}} by user #{{auth_id}}
